messages:
morgan: Planning kernel+driver+fw roll in us-west-2 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Goal: reduce Xid/ECC spikes we've seen after last patch. Need preflight checklist + rollback criteria. Who's available to run canary?

alex: I can coordinate canary. Proposal: 10 GPU nodes across 3 racks, soak 4 hours under production-like traffic. Run smoke scripts + nightly inference job.

jia: Add ECC/Xid baseline before patch. Collect counter snapshots and tail dmesg for Xid. Example commands:
```
# capture baseline
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,gpu_name,driver_version -q
sudo dmesg --level=err,warn | grep -i xid || true
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.ecc.corrected.memory.errors --format=csv
```

sam: Monitoring/alerting: set temporary alert: if Xid events per cluster > 1 per hour OR any GPU reboot event, auto-rollout pause. Also track p95 latency increase > 15%.

morgan: Rollback criteria? Hard cut: any host with >2 Xid reboots in canary or any increase in correctable ECC > 50% over baseline within soak.

alex: Soft criteria: degraded tail latency > 25% or 5% increase in token cost for gen workloads -> halt roll and run extended burnin.

devops-bot: deployment: canary started by @alex at 1991234568. Canary group: us-west-2-canary-1 (10 nodes). Tracking stream: https://telemetry/redwood/rolls/1991234567

jia: I'll instrument a light-weight KV-cache stress job and a batch inference worker to mimic production mix. Also will capture CFG: kernel version, driver, fw with:
```
uname -a && cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
sudo nvflash --list
```

sam: Ops playbook snippet (for oncall):
- If Xid spikes: ssh -> check dmesg, nvidia-smi -q, restart kubelet, then drain node for deeper repro.
- If GPU shows ECC drift: increase ECC logging, snapshot ECC counters every 5m.

morgan: Duration: 4h soak + 24h extended telemetry watch. If canary passes -> staged 20% ramp for 6h then remainder.

alex: I'll kick off canary at 03:00. @sam can you watch alerts for first 2 hours? @jia capture snapshots and post results in this thread.

sam: Yup. I'll be on pager watch. Set slack alert channel to #incidents as backup.

jia: Baseline snapshots attached (pasted):
GPU0 ECC corrected: 3
GPU1 ECC corrected: 1
Xid events (last 24h): 0

morgan: Thanks. If we see anything odd, tag me and we'll rollback. :thumbsup:

alex: launching in 10m. will post status.

devops-bot: canary completed initial rollout at 1991234790 — no immediate reboots, telemetry pass so far (1h).
